panels.title: Logical Run funnel
panels.description: Each Run is counted at most once per stage; repeated Agent-loop calls are not funnel entries.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.stage, count(DISTINCT f.run_id)::double precision AS runs
FROM analytics_run_funnel_hourly f
JOIN dashboard_tenant_scope s ON s.tenant_key=f.tenant_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.bucket_start)
  AND (${tenant:sqlstring}='__all__' OR f.tenant_key=${tenant:sqlstring})
  AND f.stage IN ('REQUESTED','QUEUED','RETRIEVED','GENERATION_STARTED','TERMINAL','COMMITTED')
GROUP BY f.stage
ORDER BY CASE f.stage WHEN 'REQUESTED' THEN 1 WHEN 'QUEUED' THEN 2 WHEN 'RETRIEVED' THEN 3 WHEN 'GENERATION_STARTED' THEN 4 WHEN 'TERMINAL' THEN 5 WHEN 'COMMITTED' THEN 6 END

panels.title: Stage-to-stage conversion
panels.description: Conversion is derived from distinct logical Runs, not physical attempts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT f.stage, count(DISTINCT f.run_id)::double precision AS runs,
    CASE f.stage WHEN 'REQUESTED' THEN 1 WHEN 'QUEUED' THEN 2 WHEN 'RETRIEVED' THEN 3 WHEN 'GENERATION_STARTED' THEN 4 WHEN 'TERMINAL' THEN 5 WHEN 'COMMITTED' THEN 6 END AS ordinal
  FROM analytics_run_funnel_hourly f
  JOIN dashboard_tenant_scope s ON s.tenant_key=f.tenant_key
  WHERE $__timeFilter(f.bucket_start)
    AND (${tenant:sqlstring}='__all__' OR f.tenant_key=${tenant:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY f.stage
)
SELECT stage, runs, runs / nullif(lag(runs) OVER (ORDER BY ordinal),0) AS conversion_from_previous
FROM counts ORDER BY ordinal

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_start,$__interval), sum(committed_runs)::double precision AS committed_runs
FROM analytics_run_business_hourly b
JOIN dashboard_tenant_scope s ON s.tenant_key=b.tenant_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
  AND (${tenant:sqlstring}='__all__' OR b.tenant_key=${tenant:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_start,$__interval), sum(terminal_successes)::double precision / nullif(sum(terminal_runs),0) AS success_rate
FROM analytics_run_business_hourly b
JOIN dashboard_tenant_scope s ON s.tenant_key=b.tenant_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
  AND (${tenant:sqlstring}='__all__' OR b.tenant_key=${tenant:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ledger cost per committed Run
panels.description: Durable analytics ledger; authoritative for business analysis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_start,$__interval), sum(cost_nanos)::double precision / 1e9 / nullif(sum(committed_runs),0) AS cost_per_run
FROM analytics_run_business_hourly b
JOIN dashboard_tenant_scope s ON s.tenant_key=b.tenant_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
  AND (${tenant:sqlstring}='__all__' OR b.tenant_key=${tenant:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_start,$__interval), max(projection_lag_seconds)::double precision AS lag_seconds
FROM analytics_run_reconciliation_hourly r
JOIN dashboard_tenant_scope s ON s.tenant_key=r.tenant_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
  AND (${tenant:sqlstring}='__all__' OR r.tenant_key=${tenant:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Source reconciliation gaps
panels.description: Any non-zero value invalidates funnel interpretation until projection replay completes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_start,$__interval), sum(source_terminal_runs-projected_terminal_runs)::double precision AS terminal_gap
FROM analytics_run_reconciliation_hourly r
JOIN dashboard_tenant_scope s ON s.tenant_key=r.tenant_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND (${tenant:sqlstring}='__all__' OR r.tenant_key=${tenant:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_start,$__interval), sum(source_committed_runs-projected_committed_runs)::double precision AS committed_gap
FROM analytics_run_reconciliation_hourly r
JOIN dashboard_tenant_scope s ON s.tenant_key=r.tenant_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND (${tenant:sqlstring}='__all__' OR r.tenant_key=${tenant:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
